# Security policy

Use the repository root [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md) for supported versions, scope, and credentials guidance.

## Reporting a Vulnerability

**Do not** open a public GitHub issue for active security findings.

Report privately via GitHub Security Advisories:

https://github.com/SafetyMP/Autonomous-EHS-Management/security/advisories/new

Include affected routes or components, reproduction steps, impact, and a suggested fix if any.
